svg.aria-label: Contoso Field Service on Azure. Users: Dispatcher, Technician; Edge: Front Door; Web front end: Web app, Web app; Container Apps environment: jobs-api, scheduling-engine; Messaging: Service Bus; Functions: notify, billing-sync; Data: Jobs, Locations, Job photos; External services: Twilio, SAP ERP, Google Maps; g9: Entra ID, Container Registry, Key Vault, App Insights, Log Analytics. Connections: Dispatcher to Entra ID (sign in (OIDC)); Technician to Entra ID (sign in (OIDC)); Dispatcher to Front Door (HTTPS); Technician to Front Door (HTTPS); Front Door to Web app (web app); Front Door to jobs-api (API calls); Web app to Web app (swap); jobs-api to Entra ID (validates tokens); jobs-api to Jobs (jobs); jobs-api to Job photos (photos); jobs-api sends events to Service Bus (job-events); Service Bus sends events to notify (events); Service Bus sends events to billing-sync (events); notify sends events to Twilio (SMS, push); billing-sync sends events to SAP ERP (completed jobs); scheduling-engine to Google Maps (route plans); scheduling-engine to Locations (locations); App Insights to Log Analytics (stores logs)

g.text: Production architecture: request path, event path, external systems
